title: The Hen and the Golden Eggs
summary: A cottager owned a marvelous hen that laid a shining egg of solid gold every single morning. The sale of these eggs brought the man and his household great comfort and ease....
keywords: the hen and the golden eggs
full_text:
A cottager owned a marvelous hen that laid a shining egg of solid gold every single morning. The sale of these eggs brought the man and his household great comfort and ease.

Yet seeing his wealth accumulate gradually, an insatiable impatience seized his heart. He thought: "This bird must have a boundless mine of pure gold hidden inside her belly! Why should I wait day after day for a single egg? I will slaughter the hen and take the entire treasure at once!"

He killed the bird and cut her open, only to find her inside exactly like any common barnyard hen. He lost both his present wealth and his future fortune in a single stroke of blind greed.
moral: Covetous impatience destroys the golden gift of steady prosperity.
